description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO, which represents a date with support for formatting via a trait. The class is part of a reporting display field subsystem in the OrangeHRM project, used to handle date display with optional aggregation.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO
classes.description: A DTO for representing a date value, capable of formatting the date for display using traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an optional date string; converts it to a DateTime object if provided.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the formatted date as a string, using a trait method.
